newsitem.title: USA: Florida woman won't tell son his dad's a killer.
newsitem.headline: Florida woman won't tell son his dad's a killer.

text.p: Kim Spradly said on Tuesday she was prepared to go to jail rather than tell her 7-year-old son Justin that his father is a convicted murderer.

Circuit Judge Patrick Kennedy ordered Kim and Kent Spradly, Justin's stepfather, to tell the boy the truth by Monday and threatened to jail Mrs. Spradly on contempt charges if she did not comply. The deadline passed but she had not been arrested by Tuesday.

The Spradlys said they planned to tell Justin the truth, but not until he was in his teens, after his formative years and when, they believe, he would be better equipped to understand the situation. He thinks Spradly is his father.
"We've pretty much decided not to tell him (Justin) anything," Spradly told Reuters on Tuesday. "I'm ready for jail if that's what's going to happen."
Justin's father, John Taylor, is serving a 50-year sentence for killing Spradly's roommate in her sleep when Justin was an infant. Police believe he meant to kill Spradly.

The conflict over whether the child knew the identify of his biological father occurred as a result of Taylor's suit for visitation rights. He demanded that Justin be taken to Ocala, Fla., where he is incarcerated, for regular visits. He also wants some control over how his son is raised.
